name: Eyal Jona
source:
Eyal is a new transfer from England. He’s had a rough year and just wants to fly under the radar. He seems to know more than he’s letting on and is always two steps ahead of Justin.  

Eyal seems to have an affinity for finding out secrets, whether he wants to know them or not.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/welcome-eyal-47603848]character introduction[/url]]
